tasks.label: Jekyll: check internal links
tasks.command: bundle exec jekyll build && bundle exec htmlproofer ./_site --assume-extension .html --disable-external

tasks.label: Jekyll: check external links
tasks.command: bundle exec jekyll build && bundle exec htmlproofer ./_site --assume-extension .html --ignore-urls "https://github.com/MettleCI/datastage-nextgen-repo-template"
